title: Twilight shift handoff: kernel + KV cache + batching sync
summary: Handoff notes from the late shift focusing on a kernel scheduling tweak, a new KV-prefill heuristic experiment, and micro-batching fairness trials. Observed a small memory regression on the CUDA attention kernel under low-batch, long-seq traffic. Prioritized actions and temporary mitigations listed.
notes: Context: shift covers 2200-0300 UTC; traffic pattern skewed to long-seq summarization jobs from two enterprise tenants.

Kernel scheduling: landed prototype round-robin affinity change (PR 6789) to reduce hotspotting on tile 3; observed 6% drop in 95th latency for short-chat requests, but slight increase for long-seq paths.

KV prefill experiment: turned on adaptive prefill threshold (alpha=0.25) for a 6-hour canary on a 4-node pool; initial hit-rate +8% for repeated prefixes but added ~1.2ms median overhead on cold-starts.
Micro-batching fairness: trialed fairness window of 15ms rather than 5ms; tail latency improved for background batch jobs but interactive p99 rose by ~4% in peak.

Memory regression: after rolling kernel revision v0.9.12 -> v0.9.13, nightly watchers flagged an extra +5% GPU memory observed on sequence length > 2048. Likely culprit: kernel scratch buffer not freed on early exit path.

Telemetry: added temporary tag `twilight-handshake` to traces for easier debugging; correlates show most regressions come from requests with function-calling payloads (200–400 extra tokens in prompt).
Oncall swap: Ben is oncall lead overnight; Maya to take first follow-up in morning. Priya owns the kernel rollback plan if memory regression worsens.
Docs/comms: posted quick note in #serving-runtime-night with experiment KPIs; cc: solutions-eng for customer impact awareness.
Unresolved: need deeper profiling of CUDA kernels under prefill + function-calls; unclear whether prefill heuristic amplification + kernel change interact to increase scratch usage.
action_items: Ben: open rollback play (RT-4123) template and rehearse rollback on canary nodes before 09:00 UTC 2028-08-24.
Maya + Arjun: run NVTX trace on failing long-seq path with prefill=on and kernel=v0.9.13; target: reproduce extra 5% memory within 2-hour session.
Lucia: throttle prefill for enterprise tenants with sequence > 1500 for the remainder of canary window; add quota flag to route rules.
Priya: add early-exit free() guard in kernel codepath and add unit test that simulates function-calling payloads (due by 2028-08-25).
Ethan: tune batching fairness window back to 10ms in the interactive pool and measure p99 for 4 hours; report by EOD.
All: document experiment config and exact node ids in Confluence (link above) so SRE can audit resource usage later.
metrics_snapshot: P95 latency (interactive pool): 184ms (down from 196ms after RR affinity)
KV cache hit-rate (experiment nodes): 68% -> 73% during hot prefixes
GPU memory delta observed: +5% on sequences >2048 after kernel bump
experiment_results: RR affinity scheduling (PR 6789): short-chat p95 improved on average 6%; long-seq p99 regressed ~3–4% in the same window.
Adaptive KV prefill (alpha=0.25): increased repeated-prefix hit-rate by +8% with median cold-start overhead of 1.2ms.
Fairness window=15ms: large-background jobs tail improved by ~12%, but interactive p99 increased ~4% — tradeoff unacceptable for interactive SLA.
Quick rollback test on single canary node restored GPU memory baseline within 2 minutes; no user-facing errors observed during rollback simulation.
blockers: Unable to reproduce memory regression locally on small dev cards; only appears on A100-80GB with multi-tenant load mix.
Profiling budget limited overnight; NVProf reservation window small, need SRE assistance to extend capture window during morning hours.
Some telemetry tags were lost for ~20 minutes during the midnight deploy; tracing team notified (RT-4118).
notes_to_self: Flag: when reverting kernel, also revert the affinity change in routing rules to avoid oscillation.
Reminder: capture a full heap snapshot after Priya's free() guard is in place to validate fix, not just delta metrics.
If rollback occurs, notify customer success for the two impacted tenants with a short incident note and mitigation timeline.
